title: Routing seam decision contract (routing authority -> caller)
description: The frozen OUTPUT half of the routing seam (issue #426, ADR-0015). The routing authority (gateway/sme-routing) writes every field here and is the single producer of all of them; the caller consumes the decision and runs the work. There is no second producer: the extracted tier-routing package from kushin77/hermes-agents#2 is a policy source we map, never a decision producer (ADR-0015). Field names align with the live authority's Decision/Outcome: tier is the effective model tier, model is the concrete model id, escalation records the ladder outcome and its terminal. See docs/contracts/routing/README.md.

tier.description: The effective model tier the authority selected for this request, after complexity bands, task overrides and the security/IaC floor. This is the authority's own field; the caller's requested tier is an input, not this value.

model.description: The concrete model id within the tier (the live authority's tier-policy models, e.g. deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro). Selected by the authority from the chosen tier and its health; the caller may not name a model directly.

escalation.description: The escalation record: what the cost-control ladder did and where it ended. A cap breach is an explicit outcome, never a silent pass.

status.description: none = the first tier accepted; climbed = the ladder advanced past the first tier; refused = a cap breach without authorisation to escalate; human_advisor = the ladder exhausted and terminated at the declared human hand-off (never an exception, never an unbounded loop).

ladder.description: The tiers attempted, in order. The declared ladder is flash -> pro -> auditor and is strictly increasing, acyclic and terminating at a null fallback.

terminal.description: The terminal outcome of the decision. A decision is not a promise: it ends in a dispatch, an explicit refusal, or a bounded human hand-off.
